h1: Custom Recycled Backpacks for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom recycled backpacks with your logo. Eco-friendly options perfect for corporate gifts and events. Shop Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled backpacks offer a sustainable alternative for bulk promotional orders without sacrificing durability or style. Made from rPET or recycled polyester, these bags divert plastic waste from landfills while providing reliable everyday carry. Whether you need branded backpacks for a trade show, employee onboarding, or a university giveaway, recycled options like the Arlo rPET Backpack or the Nomad Eco Backpack deliver performance and a clear environmental message. Screen printing or embroidery adds your logo cleanly to these textured fabrics.
heroAltText: Custom recycled backpacks in various colors with company logos, made from rPET material.
